title: LAS/SBS system updates are now generated and CLI-readable
summary: We publish updates to the Life Admin and Small Business systems. Those updates are now automated, so they're more accurate. And the `jd` command-line tool can read them and tell you what to do.
content:
We publish updates to the Life Admin and Small Business systems at Support > Updates. For example, we just renamed category 14 My online life in the Life Admin System to 14 My digital life.

These updates are now system-generated. So they'll be more accurate.

The past entries have been updated. Each entry's date now reflects the date of the change. If you follow the RSS feed you'll see a bunch of 'new' entries, dated in the past.

CLI-readable

Requires jd 5.3.0 or higher and a Pro account.

The jd command-line utility and any other tool can read these updates from the /api/v1/systems/{system}/history endpoint.

Generate an API key then type jd login.
